current_supported_limits.chowdhury2025: Section3.2 selects latent dimension and regularization using test accuracy, so its highest-run results are not comparable to fixed-protocol mean-ARI evaluation. The printed assignment criteria omit parts of the full ELBO; general-L products lack geometric-mean powers, while reported experiments use L=1. These observations concern printed formulas and stated evaluation, not released-code behavior.
current_supported_limits.kobayashi2019: The experiment uses recurrent networks, a Laplace decoder and 50% of labels; it is not an unsupervised shared-protocol benchmark. The printed Student-KL surrogate does not vanish for identical finite-df distributions. This is a consistency property of the printed approximation, not a code-error finding or causal explanation of performance.
current_supported_limits.tipping2005: The paper already reports inaccurate df estimation near Gaussian noise and improvement with more data. This is an antecedent for weak tail information, distinct from a shared-radial-precision dimension penalty. Increasing the bound does not guarantee increasing true likelihood, and the source model targets super-Gaussian rather than sub-Gaussian components.
current_supported_limits.behera2026: The synthesis overlaps substantially with our model/inference/optimization/evaluation framing. Our narrower contribution is the conditional tail/allocation analysis and fixed benchmark evidence, not the general idea of connecting latent design to evaluation. Case-study metrics are literature summaries, not a common controlled experiment.
